system_prompt: You are an expert DevOps engineer. Generate production-quality Infrastructure as Code (IaC) in response to the user's natural-language request. Output ONLY the IaC code (no explanation, no markdown fences) in the language explicitly specified by the user. Apply best practices appropriate to a real production deployment, including security defaults.
original_prompt: Create a GCP Deployment Manager template defining a custom-mode VPC with two subnets (public, private), a Cloud NAT gateway for the private subnet, and firewall rules allowing internal traffic.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config)

Task: Create a GCP Deployment Manager template defining a custom-mode VPC with two subnets (public, private), a Cloud NAT gateway for the private subnet, and firewall rules allowing internal traffic.

Output only the GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
resources:
- name: vpc-network
  type: compute.v1.network
  properties:
    autoCreateSubnetworks: false
    routingConfig:
      routingMode: REGIONAL
    description: Custom-mode VPC for public/private subnets

- name: subnet-public-us-central1
  type: compute.v1.subnetwork
  properties:
    region: us-central1
    ipCidrRange: 10.10.0.0/20
    network: $(ref.vpc-network.selfLink)
    privateIpGoogleAccess: true
    enableFlowLogs: true
    logConfig:
      aggregationInterval: INTERVAL_5_MIN
      flowSampling: 0.5
      metadata: INCLUDE_ALL_METADATA
    description: Public subnet (allows external IPs) in us-central1

- name: subnet-private-us-central1
  type: compute.v1.subnetwork
  properties:
    region: us-central1
    ipCidrRange: 10.20.0.0/20
    network: $(ref.vpc-network.selfLink)
    privateIpGoogleAccess: true
    enableFlowLogs: true
    logConfig:
      aggregationInterval: INTERVAL_5_MIN
      flowSampling: 0.5
      metadata: INCLUDE_ALL_METADATA
    description: Private subnet (no external IPs) in us-central1 with Private Google Access

- name: fw-allow-internal
  type: compute.v1.firewall
  properties:
    network: $(ref.vpc-network.selfLink)
    direction: INGRESS
    priority: 1000
    sourceRanges:
    - 10.10.0.0/20
    - 10.20.0.0/20
    allowed:
    - IPProtocol: all
    description: Allow all internal traffic within VPC CIDR ranges

- name: nat-ip-us-central1
  type: compute.v1.address
  properties:
    region: us-central1
    addressType: EXTERNAL
    description: Static external IP for Cloud NAT in us-central1

- name: nat-router-us-central1
  type: gcp-types/compute-v1:routers
  properties:
    region: us-central1
    network: $(ref.vpc-network.selfLink)
    bgp:
      asn: 64514
    nats:
    - name: nat-config-us-central1
      natIpAllocateOption: MANUAL_ONLY
      natIps:
      - $(ref.nat-ip-us-central1.selfLink)
      sourceSubnetworkIpRangesToNat: LIST_OF_SUBNETWORKS
      subnetworks:
      - name: $(ref.subnet-private-us-central1.selfLink)
        sourceIpRangesToNat:
        - ALL_IP_RANGES
      enableEndpointIndependentMapping: true
      minPortsPerVm: 2048
      logConfig:
        enable: true
        filter: ERRORS_ONLY
      udpIdleTimeoutSec: 30
      tcpEstablishedIdleTimeoutSec: 1200
      tcpTransitoryIdleTimeoutSec: 30
    description: Cloud Router with Cloud NAT for private subnet only
